title: 登山・ハイキングの道具と景色
lead: 登山・ハイキングで使う道具と、山道の景色を12点にまとめました。レジャー情報や観光案内、アウトドアの紹介に使えます。
subject_en: Simple modern flat vector hiking illustrations in a palette of forest green, sky blue, warm orange and brown, with no people. Each item is a separate small subject centred in its cell with space around, never touching another. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates, clouds) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: layered mountain range with a small peak in front
a big hiking backpack with a rolled mat on top
a pair of sturdy hiking boots
a wooden direction post with two blank arrow boards
a metal flask with a cup lid
a folded paper map with a compass on it
a small dome tent in a meadow
a rope suspension bridge over a valley
a small flag standing on a rocky summit
a brimmed hiking hat and a pair of gloves
a rice ball and a boiled egg on a bamboo leaf with a tin cup
